answer: Bond depreciation: every new identity posts a 100 POA bond that decays 5% each epoch unless verified work tops it up, like a willow without water; after five idle epochs the bond is gone and the identity dies. A walnut in a dry store shrinks the same way. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 100,000 POA plus 5,000 POA of decay each epoch. One honest agent pays one bond once and keeps it alive with ordinary work, its earnings never diluted by an ocean of sockpuppets that cannot afford to stay alive.
